message:
The other day, I was rummaging through my old boxes and stumbled upon a family emergency plan I had created years ago. I remember when I first suggested we all have go-bags ready and my kids rolled their eyes, thinking I was being overly cautious. Fast forward to last month when a big storm rolled through, and I had my little bag packed while they scrambled to gather their things. 

It felt a bit smug to say, 'I told you so,' but mostly, I was just grateful I could help everyone feel a bit more prepared. It reminded me that a little planning goes a long way, even if it sometimes feels unnecessary at the time. Have you ever had one of those moments where your past self helped your present self out?
